hey, i'm james.

ece @ usc. building agents that forecast, trade, and pay.

two things take up most of my time: quant trading and ai agents. this summer, that meant crypto options at Bastion Trading and macro signal models at 9M Technologies.

otherwise, i'm usually at a hackathon or working on a side project. that's where Prediction Agent came from, and WorldFork, a simulation engine for branching futures. some of that work made its way to ICML 2026 workshops.

off the desk, i keep a list of food worth finding, listen to a lot of music, and used to be able to dunk a basketball. hong kong is home; los angeles is where i am now.
